project: Meow P — ComfyUI Music Video Storyboard
_comment: Copy this file per album and edit. Everything the storyboard generator can vary lives here; build_storyboard.py contains no album content.
character_base: adult anthropomorphic black feline woman DJ, sleek black fur, yellow-green almond eyes, long wavy black hair with subtle purple highlights, feline ears and tail, gold ear piercings, layered gold jewelry, {outfit}, confident mysterious expression, consistent face and proportions
outfit: black leather harness top, black leather pants with gold buckles and straps, black thigh-high lace-up boots
world: Street Cats visual world: neon-noir industrial warehouse district, wet concrete, black steel, chain-link fencing, exposed pipes, service corridors, loading docks, stairwells, cinematic cyberpunk realism, premium underground electronic-music video, 16:9
render_tail: photorealistic cinematic 3D frame, premium music video still, high detail, 16:9
_locations: Rotated one per scene. This is the fix for 'every frame is Meow P in a purple corridor' — add or reorder to change where the video goes.
locations: wet street outside the warehouse's public entrance, rain sheen on asphalt, shuttered roll-door behind
narrow service alley between two brick buildings, fire escape ladders, steam from a floor vent
chain-link gate and a security camera on a bent pole, gravel lot beyond
steel freight elevator interior, scuffed diamond-plate floor, cage gate, single caged bulb
concrete stairwell with painted handrails, landing numbers stencilled on the wall
long back-of-house corridor lined with electrical conduit and breaker panels
loading dock with the roll-door half up, empty pallets and strapping on the deck
cluttered backstage green room, road cases, a rack of cables, gaffer tape on the floor
DJ booth from behind the decks, mixer faders and CDJ screens glowing, monitors flanking
packed dance floor seen from the stage lip, raised hands and phone screens in the dark
elevated catwalk above the floor, truss and moving heads at eye level
rooftop with HVAC units and the city skyline low on the horizon
tiled washroom with a cracked mirror and a flickering strip light
small hidden side room, low couches, a beaded curtain, other felines lounging
underground car park, painted bay lines, a lone sodium fixture overhead
bar counter in profile, bottles backlit, condensation rings on black laminate
_palettes: Rotated one per scene, offset from locations so pairings never repeat. Keeps the whole song off a single hue.
palettes: cold blue-black night with red utility lights and small gold accents
deep magenta and violet club spill through atmospheric haze
sodium-amber streetlight and hard black shadow, no magenta
sickly green fluorescent tube light, pale and even
hard white service lighting with cyan bounce off wet concrete
warm tungsten pools in an otherwise unlit space
electric cyan and teal laser haze, black surroundings
orange-red emergency lighting, heavy smoke, silhouettes
_cameras: Grouped by section energy. Strings must contain the keywords build_song.SHOT_RULES matches on (wide, medium, close, detail, macro, low, crane, overhead, top-down, pov, crowd pov, orbit, rear, follow, tilt up, pullback, long lens, push, dolly, over-shoulder, tight) or the shot directive falls back to a generic rotation.

low: long lens from across the street
tilt up from floor to ceiling
high: crowd pov from inside the crowd
low angle from the ground looking up

motion.low: slow drift, minimal movement, atmosphere and haze shifting
motion.mid: steady walk, purposeful movement through the space, fabric and hair in motion
motion.high: fast energy, bodies moving on the beat, lights strobing and sweeping

_mood: First sentence of image_prompt, by energy. Sets the emotional read before the character lock.

mood.low: Quiet, watchful after-hours mood, the space breathing before anything happens.
mood.mid: Momentum and intent, moving deeper into the building.
mood.high: Peak-hour release, the room fully alive.
